title: Cache-write breakdowns and cost coverage with one priced and one unpriced model
matrix: input, output, cache-read and cache-write breakdowns
policy: P9: when the 5m + 1h breakdown doesn't add up to cache_creation_input_tokens, the flat total is trusted and priced as 5m writes (ambiguous: the 1h share is then priced low).
derivation: Haiku 4.5: a [100, 50, 5m 200, 1h 100, read 1000]; b [10, 5, 5m 40] (no breakdown); c [1, 1] with total 300 but breakdown 100 + 100 -> 5m 300. Sum [111, 56, 540, 100, 1000, 3] = 1807. claude-test-1 d [5, 5] = 10, unpriced. Haiku 4.5 list prices per million: input $1, output $5, 5m write $1.25, 1h write $2, read $0.10 -> 111 + 280 + 675 + 200 + 100 = 1366 micro-dollars = $0.001366 known; 10 tokens unknown, so the month is partial.
